ownership.quote: MIOSA CLOUD Infrastructure for agent-built software.
ownership.note: No evidence found of acquisition or parent-company ownership; site and docs read as an independent, self-branded startup (also runs a sub-product 'OSA.builder'). Not confirmed via a company register/press filing.

stage.note: No YC page exists for 'miosa' (404 on ycombinator.com/companies/miosa), no Crunchbase/HN/press hits found. Could not confirm any accelerator or funding round despite multiple search attempts (DuckDuckGo, Bing, Ecosia, Google, Crunchbase, HN Algolia were all blocked, empty, or returned bot-check/no-result pages from this environment).

note: MIOSA (miosa.ai) sells sandbox/computer/deployment infrastructure for agent-built software (Firecracker sandboxes, persistent Xfce 'computer' desktops, BYOC, app deployment). No public funding, accelerator, investor, ownership, or revenue information could be located: the company site has no about/team/press/investor pages (all 404), it is not a YC company (ycombinator.com/companies/miosa returns 404), it has no visible Crunchbase profile (blocked by Cloudflare), and no Hacker News or press coverage was found. General web search engines (DuckDuckGo, Bing, Google, Ecosia, Startpage) were effectively unusable from this environment (DNS/network blocks or bot-detection challenges), which limited research depth within the ~15 minute budget. Buyers should treat MIOSA's funding/backing status as unverified rather than assume bootstrapped or independent status with high confidence.
